summary: Deforms input geometry by comparing a rest lattice or point cloud with a deformed version and applying the resulting offsets to the source geometry.

key_params.name: kernel
key_params.note: Metaball kernel function for point mode.

common_gotchas: Regular lattice mode expects matching point order and division counts between rest and deformed lattices.
Point mode only affects source points inside rest-point capture radii.
A rest lattice that does not enclose the source geometry leaves parts undeformed.
key_concepts: Lattice SOP deforms source geometry by comparing rest geometry with a deformed copy.
Its three inputs have distinct roles: geometry to deform, rest lattice/points, and deformed lattice/points.
Regular lattice mode requires matching rest/deformed grid order and divisions, typically from a Box SOP with divisions.
Point mode uses a radius and metaball-style kernel weighting around rest points.
The rest lattice or points must enclose or cover the geometry to be deformed.
